/-! Green's Open Problem 27 — imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (FormalConjectures/GreensOpenProblems/27.lean at d8d031d4998c78575159ccab9a7a9e95ce043883, Apache-2.0); adapted from `green_27.upper`: the registry's `green_27.upper.answer` (defined as `sorry`) is bound by an existential `∃ U : ℕ → ℝ`, so the statement says Bedert's upper bound `m(p) ≪ (log p)^2` is not of the true order, i.e. `m(p) = o((log p)^2)` along the primes (F11-Q24, the registry's conjectured direction); the names it takes from its file (`m`, `primesAtTop`, `upperBest`) and the registry's library (`HasNoUniqueRepresentation`) are ported under defs/ (R12). Curated by hand (curator C) and read by the lead before import (R13). -/

open Asymptotics Filter
open Green27

theorem Opn.upper :
    ∃ U : ℕ → ℝ,
    (U =o[primesAtTop] upperBest) ∧ (m =O[primesAtTop] U) := by
  sorry
